question: What do non-linearity and history buy?
goals: Learn the new words, then load and look.

Choose settings and rounds on seven folds.

weights.name: Weighting the failures up
weights.honest_label: Share of the same rows that fail
weights.why: The weight tells the model that failures are as common as survivors, and its probabilities believe it.

one_window.name: Choosing on one validation window
one_window.naive_label: Average precision of each window's winner, on its window
one_window.honest_label: The same {{ch5.n_folds}} winners, on the folds that did not choose them
one_window.why: The best of many scores on one window is partly luck, and the luck stays behind in that window.
